limitations: Complete means every source page and visible table, figure and displayed equation region was reviewed. It does not mean cell transcription or mathematical correctness was verified.
Region boxes are approximate visual extents in PDF points from the top left; table and numbered figure boxes include their captions. They are not exact cell or glyph boundaries.
Inline mathematics are recorded as page features, not individually boxed. Multi-line displayed derivations are grouped as equation regions.
Chart observations describe visible structure, without digitizing plotted data. Source annotations are independent of brewdoc output and are not expected Markdown.
